entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Can you just send me the label? Order number is VF789-01B.
Certainly, I can look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order... Okay, I see the Aero Road Helmet. What specifically is the issue?
There is no issue. The color is wrong. I just want to return it. Is it a yes or a no?
I understand. I just need to confirm a few details. So, the reason for the return is just a preference on the color of the helmet?
Yes. The box is still unopened. Look, I don't have a lot of time. Can I return it?
Okay, no problem at all. I'm just checking the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 20 days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window.
Good. So the label is coming to my email?

That's correct. I've just processed the return for you. The label should be in your inbox within the next 5 minutes. Just a reminder for any future VeloFit purchase, maintaining the integrity of the helmet is crucial for your safety on the road. Is there anything else?
No, that's all I needed. Thank you.
